rules.description:
HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client, and httpx is no longer installed automatically. Applications using custom HTTPX clients, transports, or configuration objects must migrate to their HTTPX2 equivalents.
Validation concerns: Evidence could not be verified verbatim against the source documentation.
rules.example_before: import httpx\nfrom openai import OpenAI\nclient = OpenAI(http_client=httpx.Client())
rules.example_after: import httpx2\nfrom openai import OpenAI\nclient = OpenAI(http_client=httpx2.Client())
rules.evidence:
Replace HTTPX-specific objects with the corresponding HTTPX2 objects:
Previous object
HTTPX2 object
httpx.Client
httpx2.Client
httpx.AsyncClient
httpx2.AsyncClient
httpx.Timeout
httpx2.Timeout
httpx.URL
httpx2.URL
httpx.Limits
httpx2.Limits
httpx.HTTPTransport
httpx2.HTTPTransport
httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport
httpx2.AsyncHTTPTransport
httpx.MockTransport
httpx2.MockTransport
